ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40% high-intensity (white) to 60% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, contiguous high-intensity white patches are localized at the inner proximal regions of both lobes, featuring feathered transitions into low-intensity black regions toward the trailing edges and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the central convergence of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire continuous trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature across the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of irregular, high-contrast tan and white pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible within the high-intensity white pigmentation on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the terminal tips of both lobes; potential irregular tissue loss at the outer margin of the right fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct feathered pigmentation pattern at the boundary between the black and white pixel zones.
